431:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... I only saw $n run off without saying goodbye... Or rather, flee.」

431:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Did you say something to him?」

431:t_1:86.en:
$$トライア$$
「Just some advice from an adult to a young person. ...Though maybe I was meddling where I wasn't wanted.」

431:t_1:87.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like he's got you hooked too, Chief.」

431:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When I see $n, I just can't leave him alone... It seems he stirs up that short-straw nature of mine.」

431:t_1:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, to win over even the demon Chief... That kid's talent scares me.」

431:t_1:92.en:
$$トライア$$
「I could be nicer to you too, if you didn't have that debt.」

431:t_1:93.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...How much do I owe now?」

431:t_1:94.en:
$$トライア$$
「About 864,500G, I'd say. If you collect more Reactor data, I'll pay you well for it.」

431:t_1:95.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...So, shall we get to the point?」

431:t_1:96.en:
$$トライア$$
「Are you asking about $$エスター$$?」

431:t_1:100.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I'm sorry. Give me just a little more time.」

431:t_1:101.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll save $$エスター$$, no matter what.」

431:t_1:103.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Well... If you say so, Chief, I'll believe you.」

431:t_1:104.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But are you sure you can manage? $$桂$$ told me you're pretty busy...」

431:t_1:105.en:
$$トライア$$
「Who do you think I am?」

431:t_1:106.en:
$$クロウ$$
「OK. I'm counting on you, Chief.」

431:t_1:107.en:
$$トライア$$
「You've drawn out $$リ・ブラスタＴ$$'s power yourself. I'll do my part too.」

431:t_1:108.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...We'll be setting off for $$セントラル・ベース$$ soon.」

431:t_1:109.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Though I expect we'll run into one problem after another on the way.」

431:t_1:110.en:
$$トライア$$
「I... believe you can do it, $$クロウ$$.」

431:t_1:111.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You can skip that sort of thing. It makes me worry you've got an ulterior motive.」

431:t_1:112.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Will we see each other again...?」

431:t_1:113.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If our messy ties were that easy to break, I wouldn't have all this trouble.」

431:t_1:115.en:
$$トライア$$
(That's how it is, $$エスター$$... So wait just a little longer...)

431:t_1:122.en:
$n
「We might never see each other again, but take care...」

431:t_1:123.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「This time we can both say goodbye properly.」

431:t_1:130.en:
$n
「...I really should settle things instead of leaving them half-finished inside me...」

431:t_1:133.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Everyone told me about Miss $$スズネ$$...」

431:t_1:135.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hang in there. It's no fun when you don't have any energy, $n.」

431:t_1:139.en:
$n
「If the backlash or anything else leaves me unable to fight, restore me by any means necessary.」

431:t_1:140.en:
$n
「I don't care if it's drugs or implant surgery. Use every means available.」

431:t_1:142.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. Now that I've confirmed your own wishes, I will do so.」

431:t_1:146.en: ～$$セントラル・ベース$$ Interior Facilities～

431:t_1:149.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...I won't give you to anyone.」

431:t_1:150.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Your existence is a double-edged sword for me. So... I'll keep you at my side forever.」

431:t_1:151.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I won't give you to $$アウストラリス$$ either... You're the last attachment left inside me.」

431:t_1:152.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if it destroys me... I... won't give you to anyone.」

431:t_1:154.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... I want to... kill you.」

431:t_2:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「Stop, $$竜馬$$. Shouting here won't reach $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

431:t_2:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not it! I'm angry at myself for trusting him right up until today!」

431:t_2:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If that's what you mean, all of us made the same mistake.」

431:t_2:7.en:
$$葵$$
「But it's strange... That every one of us trusted him so completely.」

431:t_2:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「When I learned $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive, I remembered $$アイム・ライアード$$ and had some doubts...」

431:t_2:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「But those faded as time passed.」

431:t_2:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's understandable, in a way. The more contact you have with someone, the more you naturally trust them.」

431:t_2:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「So newcomers like $$レド$$ had a much cooler view of things than we did.」

431:t_2:14.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't really understand it myself.」

431:t_2:15.en:
$$レド$$
「I didn't trust that man, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, but I didn't distrust him all that much either.」

431:t_2:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I can confirm this, having monitored Ensign $$レド$$'s mental and physical responses.」
